AND(OR($RecordType.Name = "Agent Acquisition",$RecordType.Name = "Renewal -Agent Acquisition"),( text(StageName)!='Prepare Quotation' && text(StageName)!='Initiate Contact' && text(StageName)!='Hot Prospect' && text(StageName)!='Quotation Rejected' ) && ( PRIORVALUE(Number_Of_Licence__c)!= Number_Of_Licence__c || PRIORVALUE(Quotation_Attached__c)!= Quotation_Attached__c ||
PRIORVALUE(Number_of_Admin_Licenses__c) != Number_of_Admin_Licenses__c || PRIORVALUE(Portal_Admin_Email__c) != Portal_Admin_Email__c|| PRIORVALUE(Required_Successful_Applications_to_Data__c ) != Required_Successful_Applications_to_Data__c || TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Agent_Reference_Check__c)) != TEXT(Agent_Reference_Check__c) || TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Branch_Conflicts_with_Maxway__c)) != TEXT(Branch_Conflicts_with_Maxway__c) ))
